title: Uniqueness of a reflection functional preserving a finite spanning set
statement: Let $U$ be a finite-dimensional $\mathbf Q$-vector space, meaning a $\mathbf Q$-module with a finite basis [def-weil-pbc-free-module]. Let $S\subseteq U$ be finite and span $U$ [def-weil-submodule-span], and let $a\in U$. For $\mathbf Q$-linear functionals $f,g:U\to\mathbf Q$, suppose $f(a)=g(a)=2$ and both maps $u\mapsto u-f(u)a$ and $u\mapsto u-g(u)a$ carry $S$ into $S$. Then $f=g$.
